name: An Average Tycoon | Anniversary
desc:
An Average Tycoon | Anniversary


This game takes place in the 2017-2019 Roblox Era


The World Is in Ruin. You and Few other survivors have left to an island to escape the on-going calamity in the world. Innocent people are being killed due to a cult that had summoned reckoning upon the world.

This Game is in Alpha and all further updates will be in the BETA version. This is now a legacy version.

 

Classic Roblox Tycoons Re-Imagined
